variant_decisions.evidence: Qere אַתָּה and ketiv את are plene and defective spellings of the same 2ms independent pronoun, so neither changes the sense. The ASV's "thou thyself" renders that pronoun and would read identically either way, and ECC.7.22 carries no mapped textual note. Nothing in the English distinguishes the two, so both readings stand and the qere base fallback carries the projection.
